subject: a young English gentleman naturalist of the 1830s with short brown hair, long side-whiskers, a high forehead and a thoughtful expression, wearing a dark tailcoat, waistcoat, white shirt with a loose neckcloth and tall boots

panels.01-beetles: a cheerful nineteen-year-old Cambridge student in an 1820s tailcoat kneeling by an old willow tree peeling back bark to find beetles, a small glass collecting jar in his hand, college buildings and a river in the distance, spring morning light
panels.02-beagle: a small three-masted Royal Navy survey ship of 1831, HMS Beagle, leaving Plymouth Sound under grey winter skies, sailors on the rigging, gulls, choppy sea, wide establishing shot
panels.03-fossils: {S} kneeling on a low pebbly sea cliff in Argentina in 1832, carefully digging out a huge fossil bone of an extinct giant mammal with a small pick, a sailor helping, a ship's boat on the beach behind, bright coastal light
panels.04-andes: {S} wrapped in a poncho, standing on a high rocky Andes mountain pass in 1835 holding up a fossil seashell to the light and studying it with a hand lens, a mule train and local guides behind him, snowy peaks, thin clear air
panels.05-galapagos: {S} sitting on black volcanic rock on a Galapagos island in 1835, writing in a small field notebook while a giant tortoise walks past and small finches and a mockingbird perch on cactus nearby, specimen bag and labelled jars beside him, hot bright sun, the Beagle anchored in the bay
panels.06-notebook: {S} at a desk in a London study in 1837 by lamplight, drawing a simple branching tree diagram in a small leather notebook, bird specimens with labels and drawers of shells around him, deep concentration
panels.07-origin: an older {S} now bald on top with a long white beard, in a dark frock coat, writing a manuscript at a cluttered desk in a quiet country house study at Down House in 1859, stacks of letters, specimen jars and a window onto a garden
panels.08-worms: an elderly {S} with a long white beard and a dark cloak, bending over flowerpots of soil and earthworms on a table in a Victorian glasshouse in 1881, watching closely with a hand lens, plants all around, soft afternoon light, gentle and curious
